props.name: children / items
props.description: MenuItem, MenuSection, MenuSeparator and SubmenuTrigger elements, or a render function over items.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the id of the activated item. The menu then closes.

props.name: selectionMode / selectedKeys / onSelectionChange
props.description: Makes items checkable; selected items show a checkmark. Can also be set per MenuSection.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the menu opens relative to its trigger. Submenus open at the end edge.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Items that can't be focused or activated.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: Content when there are no items.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Pass textValue when it isn't a plain string (used for typeahead).

props.name: id
props.description: Passed to onAction and used for selection.

props.name: description
props.description: Second line under the label, announced as its description.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut hint at the inline end, e.g. "⌘E". Display only — bind the keys yourself.

props.name: tone
props.description: danger colours the item for destructive actions.

props.name: title
props.description: Visible group heading; also the group's accessible name.

props.name: children
props.description: A pressable trigger followed by a Menu.

props.name: children
props.description: The item that opens the submenu, then the submenu.

keyboard.action: On the trigger: opens the menu and focuses the first item (↑ focuses the last).
Moves between items, skipping disabled ones.
Jumps to the first / last item.
Moves to the next item starting with the typed characters.
Opens a submenu; ← (→ in RTL) closes it.
Activates the item (or toggles it in selection mode).
Closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.

notes: role="menu" with menuitem, menuitemradio or menuitemcheckbox items depending on selectionMode.
Shortcut hints are rendered in <kbd> and announced as part of the item’s description (aria-describedby).
Danger items are marked by colour and should also say what they do ("Delete claim").

Overlays render in a portal on <body>, outside any ThemeScope. When it opens, the overlay copies data-strata-theme, data-strata-scheme and data-strata-density from the nearest [data-strata-theme] ancestor of its trigger (or of where the component is rendered, when controlled), plus dir and lang, onto its own root — so it uses the same tenant tokens and direction as the page region it came from, and nested overlays inherit from their parent overlay.
Right-to-left: set dir on the scope for layout, and wrap the app in React Aria's I18nProvider with an RTL locale so keyboard arrows and start/end placement flip too.

do: Start labels with a verb and keep them short.
Put destructive items last, after a separator.
Group related items in titled sections.
dont: Don't nest submenus more than one level.
Don't use a Menu for navigation between pages — use links or tabs.
Don't use a Menu to pick a form value — use Select.
